description: Use to find what Hacker News says about a product, company, library or topic: searches stories (default) or comments across HN history, sorted by relevance or newest, optionally limited to the last N days or a minimum points threshold. Returns title, URL, author, points, comment count, time, text excerpt and the HN link. For the live HN front page, new, best, Ask HN, Show HN and job lists use ScrapeMole Pulse: https://pulse.scrapemole.workers.dev/v1/news/hn. Paid tool: x402 USDC on Base, $0.001 per successful call; call without payment to receive the PaymentRequired object.

days.description: Only items from the last N days (1-3650).
